testcase.name: chart-incompat/helm-release/shop/web

failure.message: Helm release shop/web: chart web 2.0.0 requires Kubernetes ">=1.19.0-0 <1.25.0-0" (target 1.25)

testcase.failure: Helm release shop/web: chart web 2.0.0 requires Kubernetes ">=1.19.0-0 <1.25.0-0" (target 1.25). Chart web 2.0.0 (revision 12 of Helm release shop/web) declares kubeVersion ">=1.19.0-0 <1.25.0-0" in Chart.yaml, which Kubernetes 1.25 does not satisfy. Helm refuses to install or upgrade a chart whose kubeVersion excludes the cluster version, so once the cluster runs 1.25 every helm upgrade of this release fails until it moves to a chart version that supports 1.25. Teams: storefront Fix: upgrade the release to a chart version whose kubeVersion includes 1.25 before upgrading the cluster. References: - https://helm.sh/docs/topics/charts/#the-chartyaml-file
